stereotypeDefinition.comment: Flags files for Change Review with a Review Importance and classifications. On a folder or project it covers the custom files under it, and the deepest folder wins. On a Template Output it covers the files that template generates. The rules live in `Entries`.
stereotypeDefinition.name: File Classification

property.hint: Ordered rows, each assigning a Review Importance and classifications to the files its Glob matches. Where several rows match a file, the last matching row wins, so put a broad catch-all row (e.g. `**/*`) first and narrower exceptions after it. Add, remove and reorder rows; the property's own value is only a cache of the row labels, so never set it directly.
property.name: Entries
